title: VASP elastic tensor
description:
This workflow declaration defines the httk vasp-elastic workflow: it computes the elastic stiffness tensor of a crystal structure with VASP, from an optional tight relaxation and one fixed-cell ionic relaxation per strained cell, fitted to the stresses by least squares.
It defines the meaning of its roles: input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure whose elastic tensor is computed.
Output role relaxed_structure is a structures entry containing the relaxed structure that was strained (with relax = false, the input structure); output role elastic_tensor is a records entry containing the fitted elastic stiffness tensor in Voigt form, in GPa, in the Cartesian frame of the relaxed structure; output role compliance_tensor is a records entry containing the elastic compliance tensor in Voigt form, in GPa^-1, in the Cartesian frame of the relaxed structure; output role bulk_modulus_voigt is a records entry containing the Voigt bulk modulus, in GPa; output role bulk_modulus_reuss is a records entry containing the Reuss bulk modulus, in GPa; output role bulk_modulus_hill is a records entry containing the Hill bulk modulus, in GPa; output role shear_modulus_voigt is a records entry containing the Voigt shear modulus, in GPa; output role shear_modulus_reuss is a records entry containing the Reuss shear modulus, in GPa; output role shear_modulus_hill is a records entry containing the Hill shear modulus, in GPa; output role universal_anisotropy_index is a records entry containing the universal elastic anisotropy index; and output role elastic_result is a files entry containing elastic.json: every fit input (the strains, stresses and settings of each deformation) and the fitted values.

inputs.name: initial_structure
inputs.description: The structure whose elastic tensor is computed.

outputs.name: relaxed_structure
outputs.description: The relaxed structure that was strained (with relax = false, the input structure).

outputs.name: elastic_tensor
outputs.description: The fitted elastic stiffness tensor in Voigt form, in GPa, in the Cartesian frame of the relaxed structure.

outputs.description: The elastic compliance tensor in Voigt form, in GPa^-1, in the Cartesian frame of the relaxed structure.

outputs.name: bulk_modulus_voigt
outputs.description: The Voigt bulk modulus, in GPa.

outputs.name: bulk_modulus_reuss
outputs.description: The Reuss bulk modulus, in GPa.

outputs.name: bulk_modulus_hill
outputs.description: The Hill bulk modulus, in GPa.

outputs.name: shear_modulus_voigt
outputs.description: The Voigt shear modulus, in GPa.

outputs.name: shear_modulus_reuss
outputs.description: The Reuss shear modulus, in GPa.

outputs.name: shear_modulus_hill
outputs.description: The Hill shear modulus, in GPa.

outputs.name: elastic_result
outputs.description: elastic.json: every fit input (the strains, stresses and settings of each deformation) and the fitted values.
